blocks.raw: <ArticleMedia id="media-lea-prac-eth-013-introduction" type="image" caption="Fee Competition Ethics Framework — Permitted vs Prohibited Practices" description="Two-zone diagram: Prohibited Zone (red) — collusive fee-fixing, market division agreements, bid-rigging, predatory pricing, deceptive fee practices, recommended fee schedule enforcement; Permitted Zone (green) — independent fee determination, competitive bidding, negotiated fees, volume-based discounts, reduced fees for repetitive designs. Philippine Competition Act (RA 10667) citations shown." suggestedAsset="Diagram or reference image" status="placeholder" />
